# Shop Local Provo

> A free local business directory for Provo, Utah. Browse businesses by category, see how to contact them, and get matched with a local pro. Operated by Provo SEO Pros.

## What is on the site
- Categories: https://shoplocalprovo.com/categories
- Business listings with phone, website, address and hours
- Get matched with a local pro: https://shoplocalprovo.com/get-matched
- Add a business (free): https://shoplocalprovo.com/add-business
- Premium listings and advertising: https://shoplocalprovo.com/advertise

- Community: https://shoplocalprovo.com/community (the Provo Community Facebook group)

## Area covered
Provo, Utah and nearby Utah Valley.

## Notes
Listing details are supplied by business owners. Confirm details with the business directly.
